description: Single filer; one W-2 ($38,000 wages, $2,500 withheld); two children (ages 9 and 6, both with SSNs stored) who lived with the taxpayer all 12 months. The $4,400 tentative child tax credit is partly absorbed by the $2,435 Tax Table liability ($2,435 nonrefundable, $1,965 additional child tax credit), and the earned income credit on $38,000 with 2 qualifying children adds $4,061. Money values below are integer cents.
